title: CubeMX fails to generate Multimode Config call
content:
Using project setup from NUCLEO-U3C5ZI-Q, when ADC1>ADCs_Common_Settings>Mode is set to `Dual regular simultaneous mode only` CubeMX fails to generate the HAL_ADCEx_MultiModeConfigChannel() call to configure the ADCs for dual mode. This must be manually added by the user, otherwise the slave ADC does not trigger conversions. I believe this call was supposed to generate in MX_ADC1_Init. Am I missing something here?
